newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pacific Resources sees Q1 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pacific Resources sees Q1 net loss.

text.p: Asia Pacific Resources International Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-based pulp, paper and rayon fiber producer, said Monday it expects to report a net loss of about US$5.0 million for the first quarter of 1997.

In a statement, it said it expects to post the loss after deduction of other expenses and minority interests and in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (US GAAP).
It said that for the quarter, it expects to report income from operations of about US$5.5 million.

It noted that interest expense, which is part of its other expenses, showed a small increase from the fourth quarter due to higher interest payments. The higher payments resulted from additional debt raised through its Asian currenty note programm in the fourth quarter of 1996, it said.
Overall, net interest expense improved from the first and fourth quarter of 1996 due to higher interest rate, it said.

The company said it expects to announce preliminary earnings for the first quarter of 1997 ahead of official earnings for the period, which are expected to be reported in July after completion of an audit.
